# platform-orchestrator_pipeline (Resource)

Declarative project pipeline draft. Does not publish versions or change deployment policy. Delete archives an unused draft; retire published versions and remove policy references first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "platform-orchestrator_pipeline" "reviewed" {
  project_id = "my-project"
  document   = jsonencode(yamldecode(file("${path.module}/reviewed.yaml")))
}

# JSON alternative: document = file("${path.module}/pipeline.json")
# Import explicitly with: terraform import platform-orchestrator_pipeline.reviewed my-project/PIPELINE_UUID
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `document` (String) Canonical JSON document containing slug, name and definition. Use file() for JSON or jsonencode(yamldecode(file(...))) for YAML. Slug changes replace the draft. Secrets do not belong in this document.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project. Changing it replaces this resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Pipeline UUID. Import using project-id/pipeline-uuid.
- `resource_version` (Number) Draft revision used for optimistic concurrency. Concurrent edits fail rather than overwrite.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import platform-orchestrator_pipeline.reviewed my-project/PIPELINE_UUID
```
